headline: Star Wars Jar Jar Binks prop auction
post:
Star Wars fans, a rare piece of cinematic history is heading to Heritage Auctions! A production-used headpiece worn by Ahmed Best on the set of The Phantom Menace is currently up for sale.

This foam rubber prop helped actors have a visual reference during filming before CGI brought Jar Jar Binks to the screen. It even comes with a custom stand and a signed photo of Best in his full prosthetic suit. 🎭

Would you add this unique item to your Star Wars collection?

#StarWars #JarJarBinks #ThePhantomMenace
original_title: One of Star Wars’ Most Divisive Characters Is Behind This Unusual Auction Find — and It’s More Affordable Than You’d Think

headline: Absolute Batman introduces Barbara Gordon as the Bat
post:
Big changes are coming to the Dark Knight's world in DC Comics! According to Screen Rant, Barbara Gordon has stepped up in Absolute Batman #25 to act as "the Bat," rescuing Bruce Wayne during a brutal Batcave showdown with the Joker. Instead of taking on the traditional mantle of Robin or Batgirl, she arrives wearing a coat and cowl while driven by her personal vengeance over Jim Gordon's murder. 

While she saves Batman from the villain's jaws and joins him in fleeing the scene, the report notes that she brings no levity to the dark series. In fact, she is hardly a stalwart companion yet, as she currently lacks closure and rides off rather than sticking around to strategize with Bruce. Meanwhile, Alfred Pennyworth has announced he won't be back to Gotham for a time, leaving the comic's dynamic shifting rapidly. 🦇

What do you think of Barbara's new role as the Bat in this universe?

#AbsoluteBatman #DCComics #BarbaraGordon
original_title: DC Officially Replaces Robin As Batman’s Main Sidekick

headline: Titans: HBO succeeded where movies failed
post:
Did you know that the gritty HBO series Titans managed to succeed where four different Batman movies struggled? While the show had a tonally wobbly run from 2018 to 2023, Brenton Thwaites' portrayal of Dick Grayson delivered a conflicted antihero who became a true franchise standout. 🦇

Unlike previous big-screen adaptations that couldn't quite figure out how to handle the character, this gritty TV take gave us a fascinating look at Robin and Bruce Wayne. What is your favorite version of Robin on screen?

original_title: HBO Deserves Kudos For Succeeding Where 4 Different Batman Movies Failed

headline: Iron Fist 14 and Sabretooth value
post:
Did you know a classic Marvel comic's value is driven more by an iconic villain than the hero himself? According to ComicBook.com, Iron Fist #14 has become a major Bronze Age key issue because it features the first appearance of Sabretooth. Written by Chris Claremont with art by John Byrne, the issue introduces the monstrous character who eventually evolved into Wolverine's legendary nemesis. 🐅

High-grade copies of this 1970s rarity frequently command higher prices than the debut of Iron Fist in Marvel Premiere #15. Heritage is reportedly auctioning a 9.0 Near-Mint copy soon, continuing the strong demand for this piece of X-Men history. 

Who is your favorite X-Men villain? 🐺

#IronFist #Sabretooth #MarvelComics
original_title: Iron Fist #14 Is a Major Marvel Key, & Its Value Has Little to Do With Iron Fist

headline: Star Wars and M&M's Bizarre Crossover
post:
Remember when Star Wars teamed up with M&M's for the 2005 Mpire line? This bizarre collaboration featured candy characters dressed as iconic heroes, including Darth Vader, Luke Skywalker, and Boba Fett. 🍫

One Princess Leia figure combined the classic white gown with knee-high boots and a miniskirt, quickly becoming a huge talking point. Collectors on eBay now list this unusual item anywhere from $50 to $90!

What is the strangest Star Wars item you have ever owned?

#StarWars #PrincessLeia #MandMs
